name: TabKit – Product Tabs for WooCommerce
author: hafidg

sections.description:
TabKit lets you add extra tabs to your WooCommerce product pages — such as Size Guide, Shipping, Warranty or FAQ — using the familiar WordPress editor.

Features

  • Custom tabs per product – add, edit, remove and drag to reorder tabs, with full WordPress editor (images, links, shortcodes).
  • Saved (reusable) tabs – write a tab once under Products → Saved Tabs and add it to as many products as you like. Edit it once and every product updates.
  • Manage the default tabs – hide, rename or reorder the Description, Additional information and Reviews tabs per product.
  • One-click migration from YIKES “Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce” – copies product tabs and saved tabs. The original data is never changed or deleted, and running it again never creates duplicates. If the YIKES plugin is still active, TabKit automatically hides its copies of migrated tabs, so customers never see a tab twice.
  • Simple settings page – content formatting, tab heading, and data removal on uninstall.
  • Lightweight: no tracking, no external requests, no ads.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

TabKit is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YIKES Inc., Code Parrots, WooCommerce or Automattic. “WooCommerce” is a registered trademark of Automattic Inc.

TabKit Pro (coming soon)

TabKit Pro will add tab templates, conditional tabs by category/tag, and more. Everything in this free version stays free. Join the waitlist.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install TabKit from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, then activate it.
  3. Edit a product and open the Custom Tabs section in the Product data box.
  4. Create reusable tabs under Products → Saved Tabs.
  5. Settings and the migration tool are under Products → Tabs Settings.
sections.faq:
How do I migrate from YIKES?

Keep the YIKES plugin installed (it can be active or inactive), then go to Products → Tabs Settings and click Migrate now. TabKit copies every product tab and saved tab and shows a short report. Your YIKES data is not changed or deleted. Check a few products, then deactivate the YIKES plugin whenever you are ready. You can run the migration again at any time; already-imported tabs are skipped.

Will my tabs appear twice after migration?

No. While both plugins are active, TabKit hides the YIKES version of every tab it has imported, so each tab is shown once. YIKES tabs that were not migrated are left alone. Deactivating YIKES afterwards is still recommended, but it is not required to avoid duplicates.

Can I undo the migration?

Yes. Your YIKES data is never changed. Remove the imported tabs from the product’s Custom Tabs section (or delete the imported saved tabs) and the YIKES tabs are shown again as before.

Does editing a saved tab update every product that uses it?

Yes. Products store a link to the saved tab, not a copy.

Can I hide the Reviews or Additional information tab?

Yes, per product, in the Default WooCommerce tabs table of the Custom Tabs section.

Does TabKit collect any data?

No. It makes no external requests and does not track anything.

What happens if WooCommerce is not active?

TabKit shows a notice and does nothing else.
